description: Export a Google Docs document to pdf, docx, or txt into blob storage and return its doc_blob_key. Requires a connected account.
embedding_description: Export a Google Docs document through Drive into platform blob storage as PDF, DOCX, or plain TXT. PDF and DOCX preserve rendered formatting and images; TXT carries plain text. Returns a document blob key for email attachments or downstream plugins.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with doc_blob_key (a blob-storage reference to the exported bytes).
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Confirm the export and format used. The doc_blob_key references potentially sensitive content — surface it for downstream use but do not treat it as public.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Export a Google Docs document into blob storage.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: gsuite.invalid_params: missing id, or format is not pdf/docx/txt. gsuite.not_found: the id does not exist. gsuite.not_connected: no account linked.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: gsuite.invalid_params: pass format as pdf, docx, or txt. gsuite.not_found: the document may have been deleted. gsuite.not_connected: run connect_account.
